result.reason: The amendment is confined to the warranty subject and leaves the existing corporate and Globix provisions intact, but it does not satisfy either position. It omits the professional-and-workmanlike, legal-compliance, and malicious-code warranties; limits conformance to material respects; does not clearly cover all deliverables; and measures the software period from the Effective Date rather than delivery. The non-operative margin comment cannot cure these deficiencies.
